_about: Testbed lanes on Ben's PC. Every lane is local only: UPnP off, no router forward, never reachable by players (Foundry EULA item 2, FAQ example 3). Live is the only instance players reach.
_worlds: Chronicle Packs Desk c2/e2 (Ben 18 Nov 2026): other testbed worlds a lane can run with --world <key>. clean is wodx-clean, made from worlds/wodx-template by lanes.mjs setup-clean: every WoDX module on except the chronicle modules (those with a chronicle.mjs, so none is named here), the same other modules as the default world, the two test accounts and Start a chronicle run once. Its known-good copy is the default one's folder plus -clean.
_ignoreSettings: World settings that change on their own while a world is open (a lease, the sky, applied weather, the healing clock, the last time a GM client was ready, the session id a GM sets on first load), the once-per-world move of dawn, dusk and the sun to happening by themselves (B4895), which runs again on every lane reset because the clean copies predate it (B6500), the first-run notes the effects modules write when a GM first loads the world (B4701), and the once-per-world migration markers FXMaster and Token Magic write a little after a GM sign-in, too late for the clean fingerprint, so the next run saw them as drift and stopped (B7200: 83 exit-4 lane resets on 16 and 17 November, all 34 since job 1810 this one fxmaster key)
_hosts: B6880: the second PC (DESKTOP-S6NV3Q9) runs lane 7 with its own runner, and the Secondary PC (BENJAMIN-PC) runs lane 8 the same way (B6990).
